categories_system_key.name: categories_system_key
categories_system_key.where: "categories"."system_key" is not null and "categories"."archived_at" is null

key_wraps_device_attestation.name: key_wraps_device_attestation
key_wraps_device_attestation.value: "key_wraps"."kind" <> 'device' or ("key_wraps"."attestation" is not null and octet_length("key_wraps"."attestation") = 32 and "key_wraps"."public_key" is not null and octet_length("key_wraps"."public_key") = 32)
